name: tablewriter
readme_excerpt: TableWriter for Go tablewriter is a Go library for generating rich text-based tables with support for multiple output formats, including ASCII, Unicode, Markdown, HTML, and colorized terminals. Perfect for CLI tools, logs, and web applications.
